stay.name: Culinair Landgoed Parc Broekhuizen

packages.name: Dream & Dine Weekdays
packages.includes: A night in a room or suite for two and a 3-course dinner for two at Voltaire (can be extended to 5 or 6 courses if requested in advance)
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday; local taxes extra

packages.name: Dream & Dine Delight
packages.includes: A night in a room or suite for two, a champagne aperitif, a 5-course dinner for two at Voltaire, water, coffee or tea with friandises, and à la carte breakfast
packages.when: Wednesday to Saturday; local taxes extra

packages.name: Dream & Dine Deluxe
packages.includes: A night in a room or suite for two, a champagne aperitif, a 6-course dinner for two at Voltaire, water, coffee or tea with friandises, and à la carte breakfast
packages.when: Wednesday to Saturday; local taxes extra

packages.name: Culinary Escape
packages.includes: Two nights in a room or suite for two, a 6-course dinner with sommelier selection at Voltaire, a 3-course dinner with wine pairing at the estate’s Bistro LOF, aperitifs, and à la carte breakfast both mornings
packages.when: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday; local taxes extra

stay.note: Boutique hotel on the estate in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug: suites and lofts in the main house and rooms in the Coach House, a short walk from the restaurant.
